dedupe_keys.name: opw open spatial data portal and cross sectional survey data ireland

description: The Office of Public Works produced the Open Spatial Data Portal, which gives access to its Flood Risk Management and coastal change datasets, lidar and aerial imagery of communities, rivers and estuaries, and channel cross-sections of rivers and estuaries surveyed under the Irish regulations implementing the Floods Directive. Coverage is the Republic of Ireland. The data are free to download under the OPW terms, a worldwide royalty-free licence; other FRM datasets can be requested with a form. Caveats: some datasets are withheld for stated reasons, and the OPW gives no warranty that the data are accurate or up to date. Simulation uses: channel geometry and terrain for hydraulic flood models and flood defence design. Related records: England's reservoir flood extents (data-england-reservoir-flood-extents).
